Christopher will be coming to game days in Indianapolis to promote Rook City for the weekend of April 21, 22 (and possibly some days before and after).

The whole schedule is not yet worked out, but we have nailed down a couple of them, so start saving the dates:

Sat 11am-2pm Game Preserve Lafayette
Sat 4pm-7pm Game Preserve Greenwood

We are also talking to GP Greenwood, GP Bloomington, Comic Carnival, Downtown Comics, Arsenal, Saltire, and Gamerz.
